title: Position request decision
notes: Synthetic approval scenario grounded in the implemented position domain model; it does not assert an implemented approval workflow.
reviewQuestions: Can a leader understand the requested role, timing, ownership, and budget impact before deciding?
Does the design make a pending request and its next decision unmistakable?
outcomes: A reviewer can approve, return, or decline a single position request with its budget context.
The resulting state communicates what changed and what remains to be done.
